soil.helpTrigger: Not sure? Learn how to identify
soil.drawerSubtitle: Take a handful of moist soil, squeeze it in your palm, and see what happens.
soil.techNoteBody: Kultiva assists with day-to-day planning, but does not replace professional agronomic advice or laboratory analysis. For precise fertilization recommendations, consult an agricultural extension agent in your region.

areia.title: Sand
areia.subtitle: Loose and dries fast.
areia.handDesc: The soil crumbles completely. It won't form a ball or ribbon at all. Feels gritty and scratches your hand.

barro.title: Clay
barro.subtitle: Sticky and holds water.
barro.handDesc: The soil turns into modeling clay. Sticks to your hand, stains fingers, and forms a thin, long ribbon without breaking easily.

terra_preta.title: Dark loam
terra_preta.subtitle: Dark, loose, and fertile.
terra_preta.handDesc: Stands out for its dark color and rich earthy smell (organic matter). Resembles damp coffee grounds. Very loose, forms a clump that breaks easily when pressed.

cascalho.title: Gravel
cascalho.subtitle: Full of stones, water drains fast.
cascalho.handDesc: Full of visible small stones. Does not bind with water at all, feels loose, hard, and rough on your hand.

terra_mista.title: Loam (mixed soil)
terra_mista.subtitle: Mix of sand and clay. Great for planting.
terra_mista.handDesc: The middle ground. Forms a firm ball or thick ribbon, but breaks apart if thinned or bent. Has some clay stickiness with a bit of sand grittiness.

simulation.subtitle: Compare the recommended scenarios for your plot and pick the best one for this season.
simulation.apiError: Could not generate recommendations from the API.
simulation.whyPlantFallback: {{plant}} acts as an intermediate soil-preparation crop to protect the ground, retain moisture, recycle nutrients, and break pest cycles before the next planting.
simulation.equivalencesFallback: Alternatives such as {{alternatives}} fulfill the same agronomic role of ground cover, soil improvement, and nutrient cycling, allowing you to adapt based on local seed availability.
simulation.apiErrorFallback: Could not load recommendations from the API right now.
simulation.decisionDisclaimer: These suggestions are here to support your choice — nobody knows your land better than you. The final decision is always yours.

guandu.name: Pigeon pea
guandu.reason: Deep roots break up compacted soil.
